description: Comprehensive hazard detection and forwarding verification covering EX/MEM->EX, MEM/WB->EX, double-operand forwarding, hazard unit priority, chained dependencies, and load-use pipeline stalls with bubble insertion.
features_tested: Double operand simultaneous forwarding (rs1 from MEM/WB, rs2 from EX/MEM)
Forwarding priority (EX/MEM taking precedence over MEM/WB on same destination register)
Load-use hazard detection inserting control stall bubble
Execution accuracy without pipeline stalls on pure ALU forwarding
